question: If Glitch Interpreter is no longer on the battlefield when its first ability resolves and I control no face-down permanents, do I still manifest dread?

expected.answer: If Glitch Interpreter is no longer on the battlefield when its first ability resolves and you control no face-down permanents, you'll still manifest dread.

whyHard: The ability returns the creature and then manifests dread, so players think the creature has to be there to finish the job.
